about: Vendor Maps: businesses seen on public event exhibitor and vendor lists, sorted by category, scope and place. Business names only; contact is opt-in through Vendor Maps. We are not selling your data.

scopes.local: Seen in one city or metro area.
scopes.state: Serves or appears across one state.
scopes.regional: Appears in two to three neighboring states.
scopes.national: Serves the whole country, or appears in four or more states.

evidence_levels.event-roster: Named on the event's own published exhibitor, vendor or sponsor list.
evidence_levels.trade-show-contact: Met in person at a trade show and shared their details to be listed (owner-collected).
evidence_levels.directory-verified: Listed in one of the owner's source-verified directories, which cite the business's own pages.
evidence_levels.event-profile: Has an exhibitor profile on the event's official site.
evidence_levels.business-own-page: Stated on the business's own website; no event appearance recorded yet.
